dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast dark horizontal striations across the wing coverts creating visible light-grey banding.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible linear transition boundary between the uniform grey crown/nape and the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright rufous-brown circular patch on the dorsal crown; prominent black and white horizontal barring across the tail feathers; red orbital skin/bill base.
